title: Japanese American Seniors, Front Porch - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sharp March 1965 square snapshot capturing four elderly Japanese American adults standing side-by-side in front of a residential home porch beneath house number 3443. The gentleman on the far left wears a stylish fedora, eyeglasses, and a dark suit with a tie bar. Beside him, an older woman smiles warmly in a dark dress accented by a pearl necklace. The woman to her right wears glasses, a patterned button-down with a knit cardigan over a light-colored skirt, and the man on the far right stands quietly in a dark suit with an open-collared white shirt. The photo likely depicts Issei or Nisei community members in mid-century postwar America.
